gloss: the distant future; every place one goes

definitions.gloss: the distant future; the time ahead
definitions.explanation: The future, especially the long-term future; as an adverb, in the future, eventually.

definitions.gloss: every place one goes; wherever one goes
definitions.explanation: Every one of the places one visits; almost always in the phrase meaning 'everywhere one goes'.

examples.japanese: {先々|さきざき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I save money with the future in mind.

examples.japanese: {先々|さきざき}⟦{困|こま}らない→困る：00861_komaru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}して→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧おこう。
examples.english: Let's prepare now so we won't be in trouble later.

examples.japanese: {先々|さきざき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}きたい→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Eventually I'd like to work abroad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{先々|さきざき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: She makes friends wherever she goes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}{中|ちゅう}→旅行中：28581_ryokouchuu⟧、⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{先々|さきざき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: During the trip, I enjoyed the local food at every place we visited.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {先々|さきざき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと: matters in the future
- {先々|さきざき}⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧: to run into trouble later on
- ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{先々|さきざき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: everywhere one goes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧: the future (the standard word); {先々|さきざき} is softer and more conversational, and suggests a long stretch ahead
- ⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧: from now on (the near and continuing future)
